body: Source: GitHub issue #956. In packages/merge-forecast/lib/signals.mjs, signalCoChange scores a file pair purely on confidence (pc / minCount * 0.5) with no support floor, so two files that shared a single commit (pc = 1, minCount = 1) saturate at 0.5. Export MIN_COCHANGE_SUPPORT = 3 and require pc >= MIN_COCHANGE_SUPPORT before computing the confidence ratio in signalCoChange, matching model-router priors 3-sample bucket floor.
criteria: signalCoChange exports MIN_COCHANGE_SUPPORT = 3 and returns 0 for file pairs with fewer than 3 shared commits (pc < 3).
File pairs with pc >= 3 continue to score (pc / minCount) * 0.5 capped at 0.5.
out_of_scope: Changing coChange git log mining in @adlc/core.
title: merge-forecast: require minimum shared-commit support in signalCoChange (#956)
